intro: Rajpur Road & Dalanwala follows the long road that climbs from the Clock Tower and Paltan Bazaar up the valley towards Mussoorie, together with the localities on either side of it. Karanpur and Dalanwala lie near the centre, Jakhan sits on the upper stretch, the old settlement of Rajpur stands at the foot of the hills, and Malsi spreads along the Mussoorie Road side. Rajpur Road is one of the four major internal roads of Dehradun, and the zone runs from crowded shopfronts at its lower end to greener, cooler slopes at the upper end, where winter evenings turn cold early.

Housing changes as the road climbs. Karanpur is compact, with builder floors and small apartment buildings above or behind shops and a large population of students. Dalanwala is mostly independent houses and plots on quiet lanes, so tutors walk straight up to the door. Jakhan mixes larger family homes and villas with apartment complexes that register visitors at the gate, and much of Malsi's newer housing is in gated complexes of one- to four-bedroom flats. Rajpur's houses are often set back from the main road on slopes, which is why a map pin and a landmark matter so much for a first visit there.

No Metro Neo line serves this zone: the proposed corridors would meet at an interchange at the Clock Tower, but only the project report has been submitted. Tutors come by two-wheeler, car or auto, so the evening shopping rush on the lower road and weekend traffic heading up the valley shape the timetable. When you send a request, NXTutors looks for tutors living in your own locality first, then tutors who travel into this zone, then the rest of Dehradun, then online tutors. You get two or three matched tutors, see each fee before a free first demo, and can switch later without paying anything.
faqs: Does the Metro Neo serve any part of the Rajpur Road & Dalanwala zone yet?

No. Under the proposed Metro Neo, both corridors would meet at the Clock Tower and the east-west line would pass near Dalanwala, but the project has only reached the submitted-report stage and is not being built. Every locality in the zone, from Karanpur to Malsi, is reached by road for now.
Where in this zone will a tutor meet a society gate most often?

In Malsi and in the apartment complexes of Jakhan. Much of Malsi's newer housing is gated, so register the tutor at the main gate and ask about a regular visitor pass after the demo. In Dalanwala and much of Rajpur, independent houses mean the tutor comes straight to the front door.
Why do lesson times shift with the seasons along Rajpur Road?

Because the upper valley turns cold early on winter evenings, many families in Jakhan, Rajpur and Malsi move classes earlier in the winter months. In the monsoon, heavy showers can slow travel across the city, so a short online session on those days keeps the week's lesson from being missed.
What do home tutors charge around Rajpur Road and Dalanwala?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Each tutor sets their own fee, and you see it on the profile before the free first demo.

intro: Sahastradhara & Raipur is the north-eastern and eastern side of Dehradun. It takes in Sahastradhara Road, heading out of the city for the Sahastradhara springs, which has become one of the main corridors for new housing; Kishanpur, at the junction of the two northern corridors and bordered by Canal Road, Govind Vihar and Johri; and Raipur Road, which leads east from the Sahastradhara crossing towards Raipur. Aman Vihar, Bima Vihar, Chironwali, Ekta Vihar and Ladpur are among the colonies in between, and Sahastradhara Road itself falls in the Dehradun East postal zone.

Apartments lead the northern half of the zone. Much of the rental supply on Sahastradhara Road is in apartment complexes, and Kishanpur's housing is mostly flats, both in newer blocks and in small buildings, so a tutor's visit usually begins at a society gate with a name given to the guard. Raipur Road is different: its colonies hold everything from residential plots and villas to flats, builder floors and independent homes, so some tutors arrive at a front door and others at a building gate. The lower stretch of Sahastradhara Road also holds an office park and several hotels, which is why traffic builds there when offices close.

Further out towards Raipur, fewer tutors live close by. Metro Neo is no help yet: its proposed east-west line would terminate at Raipur, listing Upper Nathanpur and Hathikhana Chowk among future stops, though the project still awaits approval, so tutors ride two-wheelers or use cars and autos. NXTutors handles this by listing tutors from your own locality first, then tutors who travel into the zone, for example from Kishanpur, Canal Road, Jakhan, Dalanwala or Karanpur, then the wider city and online tutors. Every request returns a shortlist of two or three tutors, the fee is visible before a free first demo, and switching later is free.
faqs: Which localities send tutors into the Sahastradhara & Raipur zone most easily?

Kishanpur, Canal Road and Jakhan give the simplest journeys onto Sahastradhara Road, as they sit at the northern end of the city. For homes towards Raipur, tutors based in Dalanwala or Karanpur, or on Sahastradhara Road itself, are the practical choice, because fewer tutors live close by on that side.
Is a Metro Neo station planned anywhere in this zone?

Yes, but on paper only. Raipur is the planned eastern terminus of the proposed east-west line, and Upper Nathanpur and Hathikhana Chowk appear among its stops, yet the project awaits approval. Until that changes, tutors ride or drive in, and a colony landmark helps on the first visit.
When should lessons be timed on Sahastradhara Road and Raipur Road?

Away from office closing time, when traffic builds on the lower stretch of Sahastradhara Road, and clear of the evening build-up at the Sahastradhara crossing. When monsoon rain is heavy, families often move that day's class online, and in winter many Kishanpur households prefer an earlier start.
How many tutors does NXTutors suggest for a home in this zone?

Two or three per request. NXTutors begins with tutors in your own locality, then those who travel into Sahastradhara & Raipur, then the wider city, and lastly online teachers. You can read every tutor's fee before booking, and the opening lesson is a free demo.

intro: The Haridwar Road zone follows the city's south-eastern exit, from long-settled colonies near the centre out along National Highway 7 towards Haridwar and Rishikesh. Race Course and Nehru Colony sit close to the centre, with Araghar, Dharampur and Fuwara Chowk around them. Jogiwala grew from an old settlement into a junction where Jogiwala Chowk meets the Haridwar highway and the ring road. Doiwala, further out, is a town in its own right: a nagar palika with 20 wards and a tehsil of Dehradun district, with the city's airport close by.

Most homes in this zone are independent houses and plots, so a tutor usually arrives at the door rather than at a society gate. Race Course is dominated by individual plots, followed by two- and three-bedroom apartments; Nehru Colony mixes older houses, flats and villas beside a busy market; Jogiwala has houses, villas and some newer apartment buildings. Rail is useful here too. Dehradun railway station is close to Nehru Colony, and Doiwala railway station, on the Laksar-Dehradun line with Harrawala the next stop towards the city, lets a tutor arrive by train.

The proposed Metro Neo east-west corridor lists Araghar Chowk and Nehru Colony among its planned stations, but it is still only at the planning stage, so tutors come by road, and the junctions towards Haridwar Road and Jogiwala Chowk are busiest at office hours. For Doiwala, the realistic home tutor is usually someone living in the town or along the highway, with online lessons for specialist subjects. NXTutors follows the same order: your locality first, then tutors who travel into the zone, then the city, then online. You see each matched tutor's fee before the free first demo, and changing tutor later costs nothing.
faqs: Can a tutor reach Doiwala by train from Dehradun?

Yes. Doiwala railway station is on the Laksar-Dehradun line in the Moradabad division, with Harrawala, at Balawala, the next station towards Dehradun. Road links run along National Highway 7 as well, but most Doiwala families still find a home tutor living in the town or along the highway.
Which homes in the Haridwar Road zone need gate entry for a tutor?

Relatively few. Race Course, Jogiwala and Doiwala are mainly independent houses and plots, so tutors arrive at the door. Flats in Nehru Colony and the newer apartment buildings around Jogiwala may keep a visitor register, so tell the guard the tutor's name before the demo.
When are the junctions in this zone at their busiest?

At office hours. The junctions towards Haridwar Road near Race Course and Jogiwala Chowk, where the highway meets the ring road, slow tutors down then, and Nehru Colony's market streets fill up with shoppers in the evening. A fixed weekday slot outside those windows starts more reliably.
Can a Haridwar Road family mix home and online tutors through NXTutors?

Yes. NXTutors lists tutors near your home first, then those who travel into the zone, the rest of the city and online tutors, so a family could keep a local home tutor and add an online specialist. Each starts with a free demo, and every fee is visible beforehand.

intro: Vasant Vihar & Chakrata Road is the western housing belt of Dehradun, strung along Chakrata Road, one of the city's four major internal roads, as it leads west. Ballupur Chowk is its hub: GMS Road begins close to it, Vasant Vihar and Indira Nagar, usually written Indra Nagar Colony, lie just beyond, Kanwali sits between GMS Road and Patel Nagar, and Prem Nagar marks the western edge of the city. Vasant Vihar falls in the Dehradun West postal zone, and Balliwala Chowk is the nearest main bus stop for both Vasant Vihar and Kanwali.

Housing varies by locality. Vasant Vihar and GMS Road have apartment complexes of two to four bedrooms alongside builder floors and houses; Kanwali adds some larger gated townships; Indira Nagar is mostly plots and ready independent houses; Ballupur mixes apartments, builder floors, plots and houses; and Prem Nagar is mostly plots and independent houses on green streets, with defence areas nearby that keep their own visitor rules. In practice a tutor meets a gate register in the complexes and townships and a front door in the colonies, so tell the tutor which applies before the demo.

Because these localities sit close together, tutors from Ballupur, Vasant Vihar, GMS Road and Kanwali can move between them without crossing the busy centre, while Prem Nagar is better served by a tutor living along Chakrata Road. Ballupur Chowk is a planned stop on the proposed Metro Neo, which is not being built, so travel is by two-wheeler, car or auto, and evening traffic around the chowks and on GMS Road favours an early slot. NXTutors matches two or three tutors, nearest first, then the zone, the city and online, shows each fee before a free first demo and lets you switch later at no cost.
faqs: Do tutors in the western belt need to cross the city centre?

Usually not. Tutors living in Ballupur, Vasant Vihar, GMS Road, Kanwali or Indira Nagar can reach one another's localities directly, without going through the centre. Prem Nagar, on the western edge along Chakrata Road, is the exception, and a tutor living there or nearby is much easier to keep.
What should families in Kanwali townships and GMS Road complexes arrange for a tutor?

Gate registration. Give the guard the tutor's name before the demo and ask whether weekly visits can be covered by a standing pass. Families on the plotted lanes of Indira Nagar or in Prem Nagar's independent houses usually skip this step, since the tutor comes straight to the front door.
Is GMS Road busy in the evening?

Yes, because GMS Road carries shopping traffic as well as office traffic, and the main chowks around Ballupur and Vasant Vihar fill up at peak hours. An early-evening slot agreed in advance is easier to keep, and in winter many families in the zone move lessons earlier still.
What does home tuition cost in the Vasant Vihar & Chakrata Road zone?

Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more. Tutors set their own fees, and NXTutors shows each one before the free demo.

intro: Saharanpur Road & Clement Town covers the south-west and south of Dehradun, where National Highway 307 leaves for Saharanpur. Patel Nagar sits between the Saharanpur Road side and the city centre and is known for its industrial area as well as its homes. Majra is a developing locality close to the ISBT, Turner Road lies near the bus terminal with Subhash Nagar, Mohabbewala and Sewla Kalan around it, and Clement Town, at the southern end, is a cantonment run by its own cantonment board, quieter and greener than the rest of the zone.

The ISBT, the principal hub for intercity buses, sits in this zone, and Dehradun railway station is reached via Saharanpur Road, so this is the simplest part of the city for a tutor travelling in from elsewhere in the valley. Electric city buses were introduced in 2022. Homes are a mix: builder floors and independent houses in Patel Nagar, three-bedroom apartments as the most common home in Majra, independent houses on Turner Road, and houses and villas with some apartments in Clement Town. A new four-lane bypass being built on this side of the city may change some routes as work progresses.

Two timing points matter here. Traffic around the ISBT is heavy at peak times, and roads around the Patel Nagar industrial area are busiest at shift and office times, so lessons placed outside those hours start more reliably. Inside Clement Town cantonment, check how visitors are admitted before the first class. The proposed Metro Neo north-south corridor from the ISBT via Sewla Kalan, Lalpul and Patthari Bagh is still only planned. NXTutors lists tutors from your own locality first, then those who travel into the zone, then the city and online, shows each fee before a free demo, and keeps switching free.
faqs: Is this the easiest zone for a tutor travelling in from outside Dehradun?

Often, yes. The ISBT is the principal hub for intercity buses and sits close to Majra and Turner Road, and Dehradun railway station is reached via Saharanpur Road. A tutor arriving from elsewhere in the valley can reach these localities without crossing the whole city first.
What should a Clement Town family check before a tutor's first visit?

How the cantonment admits visitors. Clement Town is a Category-II cantonment administered by a cantonment board, so ask about passes or entry details and share them with the tutor in advance. Civilian colonies and apartment buildings elsewhere in the zone usually just register visitors at the gate.
Will the Metro Neo or the new bypass help tutors reach Patel Nagar and Majra?

Not yet. The proposed Metro Neo north-south corridor would run from the ISBT through Sewla Kalan, Lalpul and Patthari Bagh, but it is only planned. A four-lane bypass is being built near Turner Road, so some routes may change; for now tutors use a two-wheeler, car or auto.
Does NXTutors charge if a Saharanpur Road family changes tutor?

No. If the first match does not work out, you can switch to another tutor at no cost. Each request brings two or three matched tutors, nearest first, so another option is usually ready, and the new tutor also starts with a free demo after you have seen the fee.
